I am old now, so I cannot do all the heavy work myself, but my family helps me on this small plot. The rains in Mbeya are usually good, so I do not need irrigation, but I will put some fertilizer and cow manure to help the maize grow because this is our main food. I will use the improved seed that my grandson brought from town since it gives better yield, but I cannot afford chemicals for pests on such a small plot for eating. My children and grandchildren will do most of the work, though we may pay someone for a day or two to help with the hardest digging.
